evolution_rules: Position improved 5+ positions AND impressions grew -> priority_score +1, performance_signal=winning
Position worsened 5+ OR impressions dropped 20%+ -> priority_score -1, performance_signal=declining
No GSC data yet (new cluster) -> keep score, performance_signal=untapped
Spoke reached position < 5 with 500+ impressions -> health=winning, add 2 new missing_spokes
rewrite_rules: Do not rewrite articles with health=updated within 28 days of last update
Prioritize health=critical_ctr (high impressions, low CTR at good position) over health=critical
Meta-only updates for health=ctr_opportunity (good position, below-expected CTR)
